lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple high-luminance circular clusters arranged in a staggered grid pattern across the mid-lateral zone, posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of increased pixel intensity intersect with the primary circular blobs, creating identifiable anchor nodes along the central lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal features are visible on the upper flank, characterized by sharp vertical pixel intensity gradients transitioning from light (upper) to shadow (lower).

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A series of approximately five parallel, vertical linear marks of low pixel intensity (dark) are visible on the lateral flank immediately posterior to the gill slits.
